summary: Refined the orang-minyak walk clip across all six motion axes by introducing grounded weight shifts, smooth lift arcs using squared sine envelopes, asymmetric torso sway, and secondary arm overlap without altering root motion or the public API contract.
expectedEffect: The ghost silhouette displays improved weight transfer with natural vertical bobbing, well-arced leg lift intervals, and delayed arm swing matching the slender silhouette at game camera distance.
